explanation: `users[i].id` is a number (from the object literals) while `id` here is `userId`, a string (as all URL/query parameters are strings). Using strict equality `===` never coerces types, so a numeric `1` or `2` will never equal the string `'1'` or `'2'`, and the lookup silently fails, returning `null` even though a matching user exists.
prompt: Tap the line responsible for the lookup always failing.
